name: VANTAGE-NIDS
description: VANTAGE-NIDS (Verified Attack Network Traffic with Auditable Ground-truth for Evaluation) is a labeled network intrusion detection flow dataset generated in an isolated, on-premise cyber range. A single attacker host executed 67 attack scenarios across two phases. The first phase covered 47 scenarios spanning reconnaissance through LLM prompt injection. The second added 20 scenarios on modern API-security and fintech business-logic attack surfaces, including BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, JWT algorithm confusion, payment race conditions, and further botnet and brute-force volume. Targets were six vulnerable-application hosts, one SSH-only host, and a shared processing host. A scripted generator produced continuous benign background traffic throughout. Traffic was captured on the attacker's monitored interface, transferred to the processing host, and converted into per-flow feature records with CICFlowMeter v4.0. Each flow received one of nine taxonomy labels (benign, dos, ddos, exploit, reconnaissance, web_attack, bruteforce, botnet, ai_attack). Labels were assigned by matching a flow's capture timestamp against a JSONL orchestration manifest recording the exact start and end time of every scenario execution, then verifying the flow's destination address against that scenario's recorded victim.
